title: Coast Guardsman Marries his Wife, then Saves a Life
description: Petty Officer 2nd Class Zach Edwards saves a man’s life on his wedding day in Orange Beach, Alabama, Aug. 2, 2018. Just after the ceremony, Edwards swam out to save a man from drowning. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Brandon Giles and Petty Officer 3rd Class Travis Magee.
